thread:
alice: Deploybot auto-paused the 02:00 UTC rollout after an incident alert. Flagging release owners and support.

deploybot: Rollout paused: incident INC-2026-1159. Affected release: v4.1.0. All stages blocked pending manual resume.

sam: Noted. I'm seeing elevated 502s from edge gateways in us-west-2. Canaries are failing their readiness probes.

sre-oncall: Early triage: bursty node churn during scheduled scale events causing transient gateway errors. Working on mitigation: increase node drain grace period and temporarily pin node count. ETA ~40m.

lina: For safety, we should set fallback to v4.0.5 and add rollback steps to release notes. Also suggest holding the full window until the next midnight maintenance if stabilization takes longer.

derek: I'll prepare the rollback snippet and ops checklist. Who will land the release-note update?

alice: I can create a small patch to release notes with the rollback CLI and the short customer blurb. @derek please review.

sre-oncall: Change plan before any resume: set canary_percent=4, enable circuit_breaker, set drain_grace=600, pin_min_nodes=6. Auto-rollback if 5xx rate exceeds 1% in 10m.

deploybot: Applying requested pre-resume configuration:
```
set canary_percent=4
set circuit_breaker=on
set drain_grace=600
set pin_min_nodes=6
enable fallback v4.0.5
pause_until 3419999400  # tentative resume timestamp
```
Action results: canary_percent=4 \u2705, circuit_breaker=on \u2705, drain_grace=600 \u2705, pin_min_nodes=6 \u2705, fallback=v4.0.5 \u2705.

lina: Release note copy suggestion: "We have paused the v4.1.0 rollout due to transient gateway instability related to node churn during scale operations. We will resume when metrics are stable; follow-up details will be posted." Add rollback snippet for ops.

derek: Reviewed the ops checklist and rollback steps. Merging release-note patch now.

sre-oncall: I'll post health checks every 15m. If stable at tentative resume time, resume with canary=4% and monitor for 30m before further ramp. Otherwise we'll defer to the 00:00 UTC maintenance window.

alice: Thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread as the source of truth for resume/deferral decisions.
